description: Na₆MgCl₈ crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. Na is bonded to six Cl atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent MgCl₆ octahedra, and edges with eight equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-10°. There are two shorter (2.78 Å) and four longer (2.79 Å) Na-Cl bond lengths. Mg is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form MgCl₆ octahedra that share edges with twelve equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra. All Mg-Cl bond lengths are 2.53 Å. There are two inequivalent Cl sites. In the first Cl site, Cl is bonded to six equivalent Na atoms to form ClNa₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent ClNa₆ octahedra and edges with twelve equivalent ClNa₄Mg square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the second Cl site, Cl is bonded to four equivalent Na and one Mg atom to form ClNa₄Mg square pyramids that share corners with nine equivalent ClNa₄Mg square pyramids, edges with four equivalent ClNa₆ octahedra, and edges with four equivalent ClNa₄Mg square pyramids.
